title: Chinese Rings
tagline: Free the rings from the bar, one legal move at a time.
description: The classic ring-and-bar puzzle from China. Take three to nine real metal rings on and off a steel bar following one rule, and free them all. An exact counter shows the fewest moves still needed, seven hands-on lessons teach the rhythm, Hint shows the next legal move and why, and Auto Play solves the puzzle while explaining. No ads, works offline.
howToPlay: New here? Tap Learn to play: seven short hands-on lessons.
Tap a ring to take it off the bar or put it back on. Glowing rings can move right now.
Ring 1, next to the free end, always moves.
Any other ring moves only when the ring before it is on the bar and all the rings before that are off.
To go shows the fewest moves still needed from where you are.
Hint shows the next move of a shortest solution, with the reason. Undo takes a move back.
Auto Play solves the puzzle by itself and explains each move; Pause stops it.
Choose three to nine rings, Classic or Scramble, in the menu or Settings.
